records.scope: Entire untruncated javap display including all constants, methods, private path rewriting and static initialization.
records.observation: getDefaultConvertor delegates TraceName extension then exact .clog2/.clog/.rlog/.ute/.txt equality to spaced GUI labels, unknown empty string; default SLOG2 name delegates TraceName. Exact label matching in getDefaultJarName: CLOG2 clog2TOslog2.jar, CLOG clogTOslog2.jar, RLOG/UTE/TXT traceTOslog2.jar, unknown empty; no trim or null guard. getDefaultJarPath prepends nonnull nonempty dir plus FileSeparator, no existence/normalization checks; unknown label with dir yields directory plus separator. Library selection calls updateLibraryPath(base,storedFormatPath), unknown label returns dot ignoring base. Defaults FileSeparator slash/PathSeparator colon, JavaHome/ClassPath null, CLOG2/CLOG libpath empty, UTE .:/usr/lpp/ppe.perf/lib, TXT .:./trace_sample, RLOG .:../trace_rlog/lib:./trace_rlog. initializeSystemProperties explicitly reads properties and converts existing paths first old file separator to current first char, then old path separator to current first char; sets stored separator only when chars differ, then java.home/class.path. Missing/empty separator values unchecked; static initialization alone does not invoke this. replaceCharOfTraceLibPaths transforms all nonnull fields but TXT branch mistakenly reads UTE_TraceLibPath and writes TXT_TraceLibPath instead of transforming TXT. Any differing separator therefore replaces TXT defaults with UTE path (already transformed earlier in same call), including normal Windows initialization; unchanged Unix separators skip this branch and retain original TXT. UTE null with TXT nonnull would NPE, though no normal setter exposes that state. Conversion mutates global strings sequentially with no rollback. getDefaultPathToJVM builds JavaHome/sep/bin/sep/java, appends .exe whenever separator not slash, tests exists only (not regular/executable), falls back bare java if absent. Before properties initialization null home becomes literal null path. getDefaultPathToJarDir tokenizes classpath by path-separator chars, skips tokens lacking FileSeparator, returns substring before last separator of FIRST token containing one; not specifically jumpshot/converter jar, can return parent of a directory classpath entry or empty for root-level file, null if none, NPE if ClassPath uninitialized. updateLibraryPath tokenizes format path, preserves absolute tokens, replaces dot with supplied base, prefixes other relative tokens base+sep, rejoins using PathSeparator; drops empty tokens, no filesystem validation/canonicalization/quoting. Empty format path stays empty, null base rendered literal null for dot/relative paths. No executable or native library loading by this class; actual command construction remains panel scope.
